newsitem.title: LATVIA: STOCK VOLUME JUMPS, LODE UP ON BONUS.
newsitem.headline: STOCK VOLUME JUMPS, LODE UP ON BONUS.

text.p: Latvian stock volume jumped, while prices changed insignificantly on Monday and Lode Brick maker advanced on decision to give bonus shares, dealers said.
Total volume came to 220,000 lats from 72,000 on Friday.
"The volume is unexpectedly big for Monday, which might signal a good week ahead," Uldis Bulavs, a dealer of Trasta bank said.
Rietumu Bank's bourse Rietumu index rose to 227.91 from 222.84.
"Stocks might gain ground this week, if more positive information emerges ahead of shareholders' meetings," Artis Goba, a deler of Saules Bank said.
Market leader Unibanka remained stable at 4.70 lats and turned over 101,100 lats of shares, a lion's share of bourse's volume today.
Valmiera Glassfibre on the secondary list also stayed put at 2.15 lats as it saw shares worth 45,100 lats change hands.
Lode Brick maker jumped ten santimes to 2.40 lats on news about bonus shares to be available to its shareholders as of April 2. It turned over 5,200 lats of shares.
"I am afraid that the number of shares in offer is small and the price would still go up," Trasta Bulavs said.
Elsewhere on the official list Riga Transport Fleet edged up two santimes to 1.69 lats in trade of 19,000 lats. Staburadze confectionery fell one santime to 2.85 lats on a small volume of 2,600 lats.
Fish cannery Kaija on the secondary list Kaija was also comapratively busy on trade of 8,000 lats as it slippedtwo santimes to 2.33 lats.
